recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5247 unless SD reopens the broader document-bundle content policy separately.
issue_request: FHIR-5247 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification SD ballot comment for the FHIR-core Documents page. The final resolution rejected a direct-reference-only interpretation and clarified that document bundles may include resources directly or indirectly referenced from the Composition; it also asked to replace the negative "SHALL NOT include any resources not on this list" phrasing and change "i.e. recursively" to "e.g. recursively".
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 4623, preserved in git commit 5e0472eeb7347af3a0647481462f3dd6d8bb4284, which changed source/documents.html to positive "only include resources" wording and changed "i.e. recursively" to "e.g. recursively".
additional_context: source/documents.html is an active current-build narrative page listed as the Documents page in source/hierarchy.xml and source/navigation.xml. Later FHIR-6175 changed the same lead-in to "The document bundle SHALL include only:" to avoid confusion with the List resource, and FHIR-6175 is already represented on the combined branch by commit c4b7d642ecd33bfbf3de649520588d823c35afd6.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source says "The document bundle SHALL include only:" and allows supporting information that is part of the graph of resources that reference or are referenced from the composition set, either directly or indirectly (e.g., recursively in a chain). The obsolete negative/list wording and "i.e. recursively" are absent from the current source tree.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue changed the same lead-in from "resources on this list" to "include only" to avoid confusion with the List resource; it is already audited on the combined branch.
